adaptations: Exclude socket-based backend; browser networking uses the constrained wallet gateway.
Cargo manifest contains only portable library dependencies.
CLI address-count operations are exposed by the shared local core, bounded to 100,000 receive addresses.
Condition module uses portable hex encoding instead of node RPC helpers.
Pure BTC, Lightning, TRON, swap and channel helpers retain upstream tests; socket/HTTP maker clients are excluded. Networking is performed through constrained platform gateways.
